_note: Inputs for scripts/roi.py. Three scenarios: conservative / central / optimistic. 'source' says where a number comes from; 'assumed' means nobody has confirmed it. Averis answers are from Workshop 2, 21 Sep 2026 (verbal, indicative) and are quoted verbatim in docs/ROI.md.

averis_workshop2.AVERIS_CHECKS_PER_WEEK: UNKNOWN (answer 'maybe around 20 till 30' - unit not established, not used)
averis_workshop2.AVERIS_MINUTES_PER_CHECK: up to 10 for the comparison; the whole process takes longer

V.source: assumed (Averis Q1 answer 'maybe around 20 till 30' had no unit established)

t_h.source: Averis, Workshop 2, 21 Sep 2026 (verbal, indicative): 'up to 10 minutes for the comparison, the whole process takes longer' - 10 taken as the upper bound, 6-8 assumed

c_h.unit: RM per staff hour, fully loaded

p_d.unit: share of comparisons with a real discrepancy

m_h.unit: share of real discrepancies a manual check misses

N_esc.unit: errors found after B/L issue per year

m_s.unit: silent-miss rate: emails with a real discrepancy marked OK
m_s.source: measured 0 on v2 and hold-out (both hold-out FNs were escalated); 1 % stress in the conservative case

c_miss.unit: RM per escaped error, end to end

r_esc.unit: share of comparisons escalated to a person

t_r.unit: minutes to review one escalation with the evidence panel

r_fa.unit: share of comparisons flagged as MISMATCH wrongly

t_fa.unit: minutes to dismiss one false alarm

c_fa.unit: RM external cost of a false alarm that reaches the carrier
c_fa.source: assumed (Averis Q3 routing not answered); 0 when a specialist confirms before anything is sent

c_sys.source: measured: 55 % of emails make one flash-lite call; comparisons are free
